messages:
Maya: hey folks — starting week 0, quick check: who owns Private/VPC onboarding? I need KMS/HSM access, network peering, and a checklist for 'first deploy' to a customer VPC.
Owen: infra team handles the peering and project setup. ping @owen or open a ticket in #eng-infra with the tag `vpc-peering`. docs here: https://redwood.internal/docs/vpc-onboarding
Sofia: +1 to Owen. For KMS/HSM keys you also need security approval. I can paste the usual checklist below.
Sofia: ```Checklist:
- Open ENG-INFRA ticket with project ids and CIDR ranges
- Request KMS key via security request (include justification)
- Add service account and grant roles to project
- Request peering and routing review from eng-infra
- Add manifest with model pin/version and rollout policy
```
Eli: model-serving ownership is eng-runtime. For rollout/pinning questions ping @rachel or the runtime-oncall channel. If you want can add a short manifest example.
Rachel: quick manifest snippet if helpful:
```yaml
model:
  name: my-customer-model
  version: 2026-03-10-stable
  rollout: manual
```
Maya: awesome, thanks. Who triages incidents for runtime during onboarding (e.g., OOMs, timeouts)? want the escalation path documented.
Eli: runtime-oncall is first line. If it looks like infra (gpus, network) the oncall will escalate to eng-infra. If it's a regression in model behavior, product + research get looped in. Typical escalation: runtime-oncall -> eng-infra -> eng-sre -> product/SDR.
Priya: for privacy/compliance sign-off on Private deployments, security owns data handling reviews. cc @Sofia for KMS/HSM operational steps. We'll need the data flow diagram and a data retention plan.
infra-bot: INFRA-4789 created: VPC peering request for project `redwood-demo` (owner: Maya) — https://redwood.internal/tickets/INFRA-4789 :white_check_mark:
Owen: I'll host a 20-min sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to walk through the tickets and checklist. Adding meeting invite now.
Maya: perfect — I'm going to open the tickets and attach the data-flow diagram. thanks all! :party_parrot:
